designer: AI agent (Claude) proposed the candidates: physics features for unconventional pairing, measurable structure, element fractions, label-noise down-weighting, a seed bag, conventional context data and a median objective
selection: 5-fold GroupKFold by parent compound on 2,123 3DSC entries; leave-one-family-out reported separately; anchors never used for training or selection
rule: release the lowest-error design that beats the composition-only baseline on average and in at least 4 of 5 folds; otherwise the best design stays experimental
caveat: SuperCon Tc values are averages over reports of varying quality, doped entries borrow the structure of their parent compound, and picking the best of several designs on the same folds makes its score slightly optimistic

data.source: 3DSC_MP (SuperCon measured Tc matched to Materials Project structures)
data.cite: T. Sommer et al., 3DSC - a dataset of superconductors including crystal structures, Sci. Data 10, 816 (2023), doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02721-y; data CC BY 4.0, github.com/aimat-lab/3DSC

physics_features.tm_d: d electrons per transition-metal atom from charge balance (Cu2+ is d9, Fe2+ d6, Ni+ d9); each family's parent compound sits at a characteristic filling and doping moves it away
physics_features.p_cu: holes per Cu from charge balance (negative for electron doping); cuprate Tc rises and falls with it
physics_features.dome: the empirical cuprate dome 1 - 82.6 (p - 0.16)^2 (Presland and Tallon), largest at p = 0.16
physics_features.cu_layers: Cu atoms per formula unit, a proxy for the number of CuO2 planes; Tc rises from one to three planes
physics_features.heavy_block: share of Hg, Tl, Bi and Pb, the heavy-metal charge reservoirs of the highest-Tc cuprates
physics_features.fe_based: iron or nickel together with a pnictogen or chalcogen, the FeAs- or FeSe-type layer
physics_features.f_share: share of atoms with a partly filled f shell (Ce, Yb, U, Pu and others), the local moments of heavy-fermion metals
physics_features.f_count: nominal f-electron count of those atoms
physics_features.mag3d: share of magnetic 3d atoms (V to Cu), a proxy for spin fluctuations
physics_features.nonint: share of non-integer stoichiometry, which marks doped samples
physics_features.n_atoms_fu: atoms per formula unit as written, a measure of chemical complexity
physics_features.chalcogenide: share of S, Se and Te
physics_features.pnictide: share of P, As and Sb
physics_features.halide: share of F, Cl, Br and I

structure_features.crystal system and lattice centring: seven crystal systems and four centring types, one-hot
structure_features.pg_order: order of the point group, a single number for how symmetric the crystal is
structure_features.density: density from the composition and the volume per atom
structure_features.aniso: longest over geometric mean of the two shorter reduced-cell edges, a measure of layering
structure_features.c_over_a: c/a of the conventional cell for tetragonal and hexagonal crystals (1 for cubic)
structure_features.f_spacing: volume per f-electron atom to the power 1/3, a proxy for the f-f distance that decides whether f electrons stay local (the Hill limit)

changes: Adds measurable crystal structure: crystal system, centring, point-group order, volume per atom, density, layering (anisotropy and c/a) and the f-f spacing

Adds physics features proposed by the AI: the d-electron count of the transition-metal layer from charge balance, the cuprate hole doping p and its Tc dome, the number of CuO2 planes, heavy-metal charge reservoirs, the FeAs/FeSe-type layer, f-electron share and count, magnetic 3d share and a doping indicator
Adds the share of each common element

summary.rule: reported as a score only with at least 8 scored measurements; never used for training or for choosing the design
summary.about: Measured Tc of materials outside Hurricane's training data, most of them found after the 2018 SuperCon snapshot that 3DSC is built on. They are only predicted, never used for training or for choosing a design. Each entry carries a reliability grade. Only replicated, ambient-pressure, bulk measurements in Hurricane's four families are scored; thin films, high pressure, metastable states, families outside its training data and single reports are shown but not scored, and refuted claims are listed only to record why they are left out. Lattice parameters are approximate literature values for the conventional cell and serve only as model inputs.
